file: 399 This Roblox Game Made You Pay Just to Play.mp4

lines.t: For almost ten years, this Roblox game made you pay just to get in.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; weim1643 (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Welcome to Bloxburg was made in 2014 by a university student called Coeptus. It's basically The Sims on Roblox.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; weim1643 (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It used paid access. 25 Robux, just to play.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; weim1643 (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: And people still paid. It became one of the most played games on Roblox.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; weim1643 (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
